result.summary: The page is largely well-composed: header, search, category chips, promo banner, carousels and bottom nav all render consistently. Excluding the expected horizontal-carousel clipping at the right edge and the card cut off at the bottom of the viewport (both treated as features), a few minor visual/contrast issues remain: low-contrast placeholder and meta text, and a decorative banner shape slightly overlapping the promo content zone. No critical or major breakage detected.

issues.description: The search field placeholder text 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' is light gray on a light gray background, giving low contrast that may be hard to read for users with low vision.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder color (e.g., to a mid-gray meeting WCAG AA contrast against the field background) or increase the field/placeholder contrast.

issues.description: Secondary meta text such as delivery fees ('€0.90 delivery', '€2.40 delivery') and the review count '(500+)' uses a light gray that is close to the page background, reducing legibility.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker gray for secondary metadata so it meets at least WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1) against the background.

issues.description: On the green promo banner, the decorative translucent circle on the right overlaps the area behind the 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' line, creating a slightly uneven backdrop behind the text.
issues.suggestion: Keep decorative shapes behind a safe margin or reduce their opacity/size so they do not intersect the text block, preserving a clean reading area.
